headlines.title: What Coca Cola Femsa (KOF) Said on Its Q3 Earnings Call
headlines.summary: Coca Cola Femsa (NYSE:KOF) reported record third-quarter volume, with consolidated unit case volume rising 5.3% year over year to 1.1 billion. Revenue increased 10.9% to MXN 79.7 billion, while majority net income rose 5.5% to MXN 6.2 billion.

headlines.title: Can CCEP Turn Southeast Asia Momentum Into Its Next Growth Engine?
headlines.summary: CCEP's Southeast Asia revenues rose 9% in the first half of 2026, fueled by gains in the Philippines and Indonesia, as capacity expansion supports future growth.

headlines.title: Is CCEP Worth Buying as Growth Improves but Valuation Stays Rich?
headlines.summary: CCEP's strong category growth, rising profits and healthy cash flow support its outlook, but a premium valuation and cost pressures call for caution before buying.

headlines.title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (ENXTAM:CCEP) Could Be 30% Undervalued After Capacity Expansion
headlines.summary: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (ENXTAM:CCEP) has put $39.7 million into its Kewdale plant in Western Australia, adding a new can line that lifts capacity by over 40% and supports its long term production plans. Recent trading has been strong, with Coca-Cola Europacific Partners recording a 1 month share price return of 9.91% and a year to date share price gain of 31.25%. Total shareholder return of 154.

headlines.title: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners (CCEP) vs. COKE and PEP: Can New Products and Pricing Power Drive Stronger Returns?
headlines.summary: Is CCEP a good stock to buy? We came across a bullish thesis on Coca-Cola Europacific Partners PLC on Astute Optics – US’s Substack. The thesis was published on September 12th, when the stock was trading at $102.77, and CCEP gained 2.53% since then.

description: Coca-Cola Europacific Partners PLC, together with its subsidiaries, produces, distributes, and sells a range of non-alcoholic ready-to-drink beverages. It offers flavours, mixers, energy drinks, soft drinks, water, enhanced water, isotonic drinks, tea and coffee, juices, and other drinks. The company provides its products under the Coca-Cola Original Taste, Coca-Cola Zero Sugar, Diet Coke, Sprite, Sprite Zero Sugar, Fanta, Fanta Zero Sugar, Monster Energy, A&W, Absolut Vodka & SPRITE, Ades, Appletiser, aquaBona, Aquarius, BACARDÍ Mixed with Coca Cola RTD, Barista Bros, Bonaqua, BURN, Deep Spring, Dr Pepper, Dr Pepper Zero Sugar, Feral Brewing Co, Fuze Tea, Giancarlo Coffee, GLACEAU smartwater, Grinders, HALO, Jack Daniel's & Coca-Cola ready-to-drink, Kristal, L&P, MER, Minute Maid, Mother, Mount Franklin, Nordic Mist, Nutriboost, Oasis, Pulpy, pump, pumped, Reign, Rekorderlig Cider, Relentless, Royal, Royal Bliss, Schweppes, Schweppes Mix, SOCO, URGE, Vilas del Turbón, Voyage, Wilkins Pure, and Zephyr Coffee Co brands. It is also involved in the bottling and other operations. The company was formerly known as Coca-Cola European Partners plc and changed its name to Coca-Cola Europacific Partners PLC in May 2021. The company was founded in 1904 and is based in Uxbridge, United Kingdom.
